title: print HTTPS LAN URL from dev server
problem_statement: Terminal output must include an HTTPS URL usable by other PCs on the same LAN.
validated_decisions: To make LAN URLs usable, the default bind host must be reachable from LAN, not only `localhost`.
The local certificate must include the detected LAN IP in SAN to avoid an avoidable name mismatch.
draft_assumptions_in_play: The default-route source IPv4 address is the LAN URL to print.
Firewall rules are outside repo scope.
current_direction: Print `LAN: https://<lan-ip>:<port>` for detected default-route LAN IP.
Regenerate default local cert when the current LAN IP is missing from SAN.
backward_compatibility_concerns: Default bind host changed from loopback to all interfaces.
LAN access may still be blocked by OS firewall outside repo control.
required_validations: HTTPS LAN IP curl smoke test
human_test_checklist: Use the printed `LAN:` URL from another device on the same Wi-Fi/LAN.
Accept local self-signed certificate warning if prompted.
solution_applied: Terminal output prints local `Open:` URL and one or more LAN URLs.
Default dev certificate SAN includes the detected LAN IP.
README documents the LAN URL output.
decision_log_summary: Task-orchestrator approved direct build because this is local tooling only.
Build-agent implemented LAN URL printing, all-interface bind, and LAN IP cert SAN refresh.
Review-maintainability-guard approved with expected notes around firewall and self-signed browser warnings.
